Status snapshot — 16 July 2026. The project has gone from research draft (May 2026) to a live, public, multi-user application in roughly two months, and every planned product milestone through the Libraries milestone has shipped: navigator, relevance, canon import, library scoping (L0–L5), library-aware availability badges, and the full design reskin (both phases). The centre of gravity is M7 — the network-wide backlist crawl: the mirror has ~2.4×'d since early July to 300k records (17.9% of the TITN space), draining a steady ~32k backlist tasks/day within the same 1 req/s politeness budget — backlist 15.7% swept, ETA down to ~75 days. That scale surfaced three reliability failure modes, all now fixed back-to-back: a browser-fetch hang (07-09), hourly runs pegging the NAS CPU (07-13), and a 4-hourly canon-resolve query timeout (07-14). The long-stalled shelf-resolve job is now resolving on-OPAC. Chat & Recommendations P1 (feedback buttons → weighted taste centroid → cache busting) shipped 2026-07-16; next up its read-loop (P2), a crawl-plane alerting layer, and keeping enrichment (embeddings) caught up with the faster mirror.

What it is

The official OPAC (AbsysNET, run by the Junta de Andalucía) is fine if you already know the title you want. biblioHack keeps a polite, local mirror of the catalogue — bootstrapped from the Biblioteca Provincial de Huelva — so you can explore it like a bookshop: accent-insensitive Spanish full-text search, semantic "more like this", live per-branch availability badges, book covers, a Goodreads-imported personal shelf, and per-user AI recommendations. Python/FastAPI hexagonal backend, Astro + React-islands frontend, Postgres (TimescaleDB + pgvector), self-hosted on a Synology NAS behind a Cloudflare Tunnel. Full design in Architecture.

What's next (priorities as of 2026-07-16)

Just shipped — Chat & Recommendations P1 (2026-07-16): feedback buttons (like / dislike / más-como-esto / no-me-interesa) + the recommendation_feedback table (migration 0023) + the weighted taste centroid + feedback-hash cache busting. Next Chat step is P2 (the read-after-recommended loop). Full plan: Chat & Recommendations.

1 · Crawl-plane alerting: the 07-03 → 07-09 hangs were only caught by eye on Grafana. The code fixes bound the hangs, but the detection layer is still unbuilt — a Loki alert on the «job is still running» supercronic message plus Grafana staleness alerts (heartbeat > ~9h, 0 records in 3h).

2 · Keep enrichment on pace: whole-mirror embedding coverage has fallen to 19.6% (from ~32%) because the mirror is growing ~20k/day faster than the embed job — raise EMBED_MAX. Also a bounded requeue for the 424 failed scrape tasks so transient OPAC wobbles self-heal.

3 · Canon follow-up: OL rating collection still has only 3 ratings stored — the enrich-ratings pipeline needs a look before the rating signal can meaningfully feed the boost.

Parked (external): the MARC-dump request to the Junta — one «sí» would obsolete ~90% of the crawl; draft ready at docs/outreach/marc-dump-request.md.
